description:
modules/traegerview — GET /traeger/schools/day-changes (#7672, #8146): in one
administrative transaction the Träger with its schools and their names
(Organisation & Tenancy, one statement), the closing days of the schools
and of the Träger with the opening changes (School Calendar, one
statement), the cancelled blocks, the cancelled lunches and the closed
rooms for the whole school set. Flat in the number of schools.
